name: call_gp_api
description: Llama a un endpoint de la GP API REST. OBLIGATORIO - Usar exactamente estas rutas: /gp/dashboard (AUM, KPIs), /gp/funds (listar), /gp/funds/:id (detalle), /gp/funds/:id/lps (LPs), /gp/capital-calls, /gp/payments, /gp/analytics?q=pending_by_lp (deudas), /gp/analytics?q=overdue_capital_calls (vencidas), /gp/analytics?q=fund_collection_rate (cobranza), /gp/analytics?q=lp_ranking&metric=paid (ranking)
